body:
Founder real-time (2026-09-12): "we are gonna need to build our own tools to create the
textures... lets build it on top of imagemagic for now and add cli affordances for everything in
our app FIRST... lets yolo it into iduna... this project is called NOCK" -- then mid-build: "just
get it working in whatever technology will get it working fastest" + "REACT... TYPESCRIPT...
whatever the newest react idioms are."

Shipped a real, working v0: internal/nock (ImageMagick-6-backed layered image engine -- layers,
masks, opacity, gradients, hue/saturation, sharpen, resize, PNG/JPEG export), cmd/nock (CLI over
the same engine, live end-to-end verified), internal/http/handlers/nock.go (JSON API), and a real
React 19 + TypeScript SPA at /admin/nock (Vite, function components + hooks, go:embed'd into the
IDUNA binary). 13 tests total (10 engine + 3 handler), all against the real installed ImageMagick
binary, not mocked. go build/vet/test ./... clean.

Deliberately not GFD-coupled per the founder's own explicit instruction. Full phased plan and
honest scope (deferred: layer transforms, non-destructive edits, PARENA backend, 3D modeler,
level editor, PE macros) in docs/NOCK_NORTHSTAR.md.

Real, honest gap: not live-verified against a running IDUNA process (deliberately didn't
restart the live production instance on this box to test).

IDUNA commit fbdafa3.
